summary: Component catalog is the generated inventory of exported Bunraku UI entries. scripts/hooks/component-catalog.ts scans React components throughout src/ui plus exported create/build/swatch/inject helpers under src/ui/_shared. Authors do not hand-edit the markdown: regenerate it with bun run scripts/hooks/component-catalog.ts, and the pre-commit --check gate fails when live exports drift. Each row records Name, source File, TypeScript Signature, optional Doc blurb, and Styles class list. Before building a control, scan this catalog and reuse an existing entry rather than inventing a twin. The two tables distinguish React `.tsx` components from shared `.ts` UI helpers; that distinction is file shape and API role, not a claim that helpers are legacy or awaiting migration. Use the catalog as lookup authority for props and file homes; behavior and layout truth remain in reference/ui and the owning source. The catalog also includes the cover composer, context-menu button, reusable proscenium and capped LightRays effect used by the approved premiere layout. It also lists the Context wing parts under src/ui/apps/scenes/context (the wing shell and its resize edge, This turn, Next send, Lore & state with its Macros view, the pressure bar and the Memory controls), the Messenger shell, panels and settings rows under src/ui/apps/scenes/messenger, the Booth's Chat Summary row and Settings > Memory & Summaries. It also lists the shared RoomHeader (kicker, title, lede, actions) and Panel (framed section) components with the agent room's RoomFrame and DockedHead, the EditorEhead kind and deck props, and the restyled CSS Workshop, Macro Lab and Settings rooms.

sections.title: Use this for
sections.summary: A short table answers the common UI needs before anyone searches the full catalog. Any action with text uses the Button from the button family, with one primary per view, danger for destructive actions and quiet for low emphasis. An icon-only action is an IconButton with a label; a few options are a Segmented; sections of a room or editor are Tabs; a small on/off filter or tag is a Chip; a clickable row is a ListRow, a menu entry a MenuItem, a fold a Disclosure, a small square target a Tile, a larger face a Card, a tiny mark a Dot. It also names the icon door Ic, SwatchRow and PaintPicker for colors, Toggle for switches, InkDialog or DialogCore for dialogs, and the three theme font tokens. For buttons, color pickers and fonts, lint and the style guard block the alternatives; the rest is the house answer that review checks.

sections.title: Components (React, `.tsx`)
sections.summary: The React table lists exported UI components by name, source file, TypeScript signature and optional documentation and styles links. It covers the shell, Dock, shared controls, Library, Workbench editors, Scenes, and Settings and documentation surfaces. BookCover composes lorebook presentation, Proscenium frames scene artwork, and LightRays supplies capped premiere beams. Rows are generated discovery metadata, not proof of behavior or a second registry; consult reference/ui and source for the live contract. It also lists the Stage AccentRow, Compendium Settings tab, the Participants rows with the Add participant form, the Storyboards dossier, the Props wing with its tracker panels, and the Messenger shell, panels and settings rows (including the Compendium, Final Cut, models and prompt rows) and the shared VirtualRows and VirtualShelf lists. It lists the shared RoomHeader and Panel, the IconPicker and NumberInput controls and the field editor a tracker and a tool share, the Agent room's RoomFrame and DockedHead, EditorEhead with its optional kind and deck props, and the Settings StageLightsRow and ProtectedLine.

sections.title: Shared UI helpers (`src/ui/_shared`, `.ts`)
sections.summary: Secondary table for exported TypeScript UI helpers under src/ui/_shared whose names begin create, build, swatch, or inject. These are ordinary `.ts` functions rather than JSX components; the table makes no deprecation or migration claim. It uses the same Name, File, Signature, Doc, and Styles columns as the React table. Current entries are buildTimeline from version-history, a pure helper the Updates surface uses to derive release relations and behind counts, and createArtCache, the bounded in-memory art cache that dedupes decrypted portraits and revokes its object URLs on eviction or clear (the app's singleton is also cleared on library lock). Regenerating the catalog adds or removes rows as matching exports change. Open this table when a UI task needs shared computation or construction logic, and open the React table when it needs a rendered control.
